network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
passwordTooCommon: This password is too common. Please choose a stronger one.
resetLinkInvalid: This link has expired or already been used.
accountLabelNotUnique: Another account at this institution already uses this label. Give this one a nickname to tell them apart.
accountNameRequired: A name is required for an account with no institution.
movementTypeInvalidForArchetype: A {{type}} cannot be recorded against {{asset}}, because it is {{archetype}}. Try {{suggestions}} instead.
movementAssetRequired: A {{type}} always applies to a specific holding — choose which one.
movementQuantityForbidden: A {{type}} does not change how many units you hold — leave the quantity empty.
movementQuantityNotPositive: A {{type}} adds units to the holding, so enter how many were added.
movementQuantityNotNegative: A {{type}} removes units from the holding, so enter how many left.
movementQuantityZero: A {{type}} has to change the number of units held — zero records nothing.
movementQuantityRequired: {{asset}} is counted in units, so a purchase has to say how many were bought. Only fixed income bought as a lump sum may leave this empty.
movementCashNotNegative: A {{type}} takes money out of the account — enter what you paid.
movementCashNotPositive: A {{type}} puts money into the account — enter what you received.
movementCashNotZero: A {{type}} moves no money; only the units held change.
movementUnitPriceRequired: You said how many units moved, so the price per unit is needed to value them.
movementUnitPriceForbidden: A {{type}} has no price per unit — only a buy or a sell does.
movementFeeForbidden: A {{type}} cannot carry a fee. Record the fee as its own Fee or Tax entry.
movementFeeNegative: Enter the fee as a positive amount; it is already included in the total.
movementFeeCurrencyMismatch: The fee has to be in {{currency}}, the same currency as the movement.
movementLotRequired: Choose which contribution this {{type}} draws from.
movementLotForbidden: A {{type}} applies to the whole holding, so it does not draw from a single contribution.
movementLotNotAccepted: A {{type}} opens a new contribution of its own; it cannot be added to an existing one.
movementLotOverdrawn: {{label}} has {{remaining}} left on {{date}}, and this entry needs {{needed}}.
movementLotExhausted: {{label}} has already been fully drawn down; there is nothing left to take out.
movementLotInUse: Other entries still draw from {{label}}. Void those first.
movementCurrencyNotNative: {{subject}} is held in {{currency}}, so the movement is recorded in {{currency}}.
movementFxRateNotOne: The movement is already in {{currency}}, the account's own currency, so no conversion applies.
movementFxRateMissing: This movement is in {{currency}} but the account reports in {{base}} — enter the rate used on {{date}}.
movementFxRateUnresolvable: No {{currency}} to {{base}} rate is on file for {{date}}. Enter the rate you used.
movementFxRateInvalid: The exchange rate has to be greater than zero.
movementUseRecordTransfer: A transfer moves money between two of your accounts, so it is recorded as a transfer rather than as a single entry.
movementTransferSameAccount: A transfer needs two different accounts — pick a destination other than {{account}}.
movementTransferSourceLotRequired: Choose which contribution is being transferred out.
movementTransferNotReplaceable: A transfer's two halves are corrected together: void it and record it again.
movementTransferLinkForbidden: Only the incoming half of a transfer records the link to its pair.
movementTransferPairInvalid: The two halves of a transfer must move the same holding between two different accounts.
movementAlreadyVoided: This entry was already voided on {{date}}.
movementShapeInvalid: The amounts entered do not match what this kind of entry allows.
assetCertificateIssuerRequired: A certificate is a debt of a specific bank — name the institution that issued it.
assetBondIssuerNameRequired: Say who issued this bond, either as one of your institutions or by name.
assetCertificateNoCoupon: A certificate pays everything back at maturity, so it has no periodic payment to schedule.
assetCouponRateMissing: This pays every {{frequency}}, so it needs the rate it pays. Enter zero only if it pays nothing until maturity.
assetCouponFrequencyMissing: This pays a rate periodically, so it needs to say how often. Set the rate to zero if it pays nothing until maturity.
assetFieldRequired: This is required for a {{archetype}} asset.
assetFieldNotApplicable: This does not apply to a {{archetype}} asset.
assetPricingModeMismatch: A {{archetype}} asset is always priced as {{mode}}.
